extracted.intended_audience: news organizations, startups, individual bloggers and journalists
extracted.subtask_description: A resource list of existing journalism and newsroom ethics codes intended to help news organisations, startups and individual journalists craft or adapt their own codes of ethics and standards. The page compiles names of professional codes and guidelines consulted for ONA's Build Your Own Ethics Code project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Online News Association Build Your Own Ethics Code project
rubrics_metrics.description: The Online News Association’s Build Your Own Ethics Code project is designed to help news organizations, startups and individual bloggers and journalists create codes that reflect their own journalistic principles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This ONA project is presented as the purpose of the page: a tool/resource to help create customised ethics codes. The page itself only lists consulted codes and does not provide the project's internal rubric or step-by-step criteria.
